issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Appendix B Type Operators, conversion table and ConvertsToString/ToString
issues.evidence: Fresh EXPLORER probe: native and forced Python fallback return true for ConvertsToString([1, 2]), ConvertsToString({'a': 1}), and translated CQL ConvertsToString({1, 2}) / ConvertsToString(Tuple { a: 1 }); ToString over those structural values returns DuckDB-cast text instead of NULL. The CQL conversion table defines String conversions for scalar primitive/temporal/Quantity/Ratio values, not List or Tuple.
issues.root_cause: Public ToString was a bare DuckDB CAST macro and translated generic ToString bypassed the macro with SQLCast, so structural CQL List/Tuple values inherited DuckDB stringification. ConvertsToString was a broad Python UDF returning true for every non-null value.
issues.resolution: Added structural type guards to the ToString and ConvertsToString macros, stopped registering the broad ConvertsToString Python UDF over that macro, hardened the fallback Python helper for direct list/dict values, and routed generic translated ToString through the public macro while preserving QuantityToString/RatioToString special cases.
